title: Pure Legendary Dragon
summary: Yugi, Kaiba, and Joey's Waking the Dragons strategy uniting The Eye of Timaeus, The Fang of Critias, and The Claw of Hermos with a compact Dark Magician and Trap Trick engine. Each Legendary Dragon Spell cheats out its signature Fusion from the Extra Deck, then Legend of Heart banishes all three Spells from the hand or GY to summon the three Legendary Knights and fuse them into Timaeus the Knight of Destiny.

summary.title: Starters
points: Illusion of Chaos reveals itself in hand to search Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant or Magician's Rod and places a card from your hand on top of the Deck.

Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant counts as Dark Magician on the field: revealing a Spell Special Summons it from the hand, immediately making The Eye of Timaeus live, and Sets The Eye of Timaeus or Legend of Heart from the Deck.
Magician's Rod searches any Spell/Trap that mentions Dark Magician on Normal Summon, including The Eye of Timaeus and Legend of Heart.
Trap Trick banishes Mirror Force or Crush Card Virus from the Deck to Set a second copy directly to your field, supplying the exact Trap needed for The Fang of Critias.

summary.title: Opening: Pharaoh's Servant + The Eye of Timaeus or Timaeus the United Dragon
steps: Reveal a Spell to Special Summon Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant from your hand, Setting The Eye of Timaeus from the Deck.

Activate The Eye of Timaeus targeting Dark Magician (or summon Timaeus the United Dragon by sending a Spellcaster or Dark Magician Spell/Trap to the GY and use its Main Phase Fusion effect) to Fusion Summon Dark Magician the Dragon Knight.
Set Mirror Force, Crush Card Virus, or Trap Trick alongside your face-up Spells/Traps, which Dark Magician the Dragon Knight protects from targeting and destruction.

summary.title: The Three Legendary Dragon Spells
points: The Eye of Timaeus targets a Dark Magician monster you control to Fusion Summon Dark Magician the Dragon Knight or Amulet Dragon with a single material.
The Fang of Critias sends Mirror Force or Crush Card Virus from your hand or field to the GY to Special Summon Mirror Force Dragon or Doom Virus Dragon.

The Claw of Hermos sends a Spellcaster, Warrior, or Dragon from your hand or field to the GY to Special Summon Time Magic Hammer, Goddess Bow, or Red-Eyes Black Dragon Sword and equip it to a monster on the field.

summary.title: Bosses & Legend of Heart
points: Dark Magician the Dragon Knight counts as Dark Magician on the field and in the GY while making all Spells and Traps you control untargetable and indestructible.

Mirror Force Dragon destroys all cards the opponent controls whenever a monster you control is targeted for an attack or by an opposing card effect, while Doom Virus Dragon destroys all 1500+ ATK monsters in the opponent's field, hand, and next three draws.

Legend of Heart pays 2000 LP, Tributes a Warrior, and banishes up to three differently named Legendary Dragon Spells from your hand/GY to Special Summon Legendary Knight Timaeus, Legendary Knight Critias, and Legendary Knight Hermos, which banish up to three face-up Spells/Traps and combine into the unaffected Timaeus the Knight of Destiny.

allow.Dark Magician: Required target on the field for The Eye of Timaeus to Fusion Summon Dark Magician the Dragon Knight or Amulet Dragon.
allow.Magician's Rod: Level 3 DARK Spellcaster: adds 1 Spell/Trap that lists 'Dark Magician' (The Eye of Timaeus or Legend of Heart) from your Deck to your hand on Normal Summon.
allow.Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant: 2026 Dark Magician that summons itself by revealing a Spell and Sets The Eye of Timaeus or Legend of Heart from the Deck; puts a Dark Magician on the field for The Eye of Timaeus. Replaces Magicians' Souls, Forbidden since October 2026.
allow.Illusion of Chaos: Searches Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant or Magician's Rod and puts a card back on top of the Deck.
allow.Mirror Force: Named Trap material for The Fang of Critias to Special Summon Mirror Force Dragon from the Extra Deck!
allow.Crush Card Virus: Named Trap material for The Fang of Critias to Special Summon Doom Virus Dragon from the Extra Deck!
allow.Trap Trick: Banishes 1 Mirror Force or Crush Card Virus from your Deck to Set another copy directly to your field—immediately giving you the Trap required to activate The Fang of Critias!
allow.Dark Magician the Dragon Knight: Level 8 Dragon Fusion summoned via The Eye of Timaeus + Dark Magician or Timaeus the United Dragon that makes all Spells/Traps you control untargetable and indestructible!
allow.Amulet Dragon: Level 8 Dragon Fusion summoned via The Eye of Timaeus + Dark Magician that banishes Spells from either GY to gain ATK.

main: The Eye of Timaeus
Legendary Dragon Spell: targets 1 'Dark Magician' monster you control and Fusion Summons a Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck that lists it as material.
The Fang of Critias
Legendary Dragon Spell: sends 1 Trap Card from your hand or field to the GY (Mirror Force or Crush Card Virus!) to Special Summon the corresponding Critias Fusion Dragon from your Extra Deck.
The Claw of Hermos

Legendary Dragon Spell: sends 1 monster of a listed Type (Spellcaster, Warrior, or Dragon) from your hand or field to the GY to Special Summon the corresponding Hermos Equip Fusion from your Extra Deck.
Legend of Heart

Signature Spell: pays 2000 LP, tributes 1 Warrior monster, and banishes up to 3 'Legendary Dragon' Spells with different names from your hand/GY to Special Summon Legendary Knight Timaeus, Critias, and Hermos!
Legendary Knight Timaeus

Summoned by Legend of Heart: banishes 1 face-up Spell/Trap on Special Summon, copies the ATK of the highest-ATK monster on the field during attack, and tributes all 3 Legendary Knights to summon Timaeus the Knight of Destiny!
Legendary Knight Critias
Summoned by Legend of Heart: banishes 1 face-up Spell/Trap on Special Summon, and Sets 1 Trap from your GY when targeted for an attack.
Legendary Knight Hermos
Summoned by Legend of Heart: banishes 1 face-up Spell/Trap on Special Summon, and copies a GY Effect Monster's effect once per turn.
Timaeus the United Dragon
Level 8 LIGHT Dragon that sends 1 Spellcaster or Spell/Trap mentioning Dark Magician to GY to Special Summon itself, and Fusion Summons a Fusion Monster during your Main Phase!
Dark Magician
The Dark Magician The Eye of Timaeus, Timaeus the United Dragon, and The Claw of Hermos want on the field; Illusion of Chaos and Magician's Rod find it.
Magician's Rod
Adds 1 Spell/Trap that lists 'Dark Magician' (The Eye of Timaeus or Legend of Heart) from your Deck to your hand on Normal Summon.
Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant

Counts as Dark Magician on the field: reveals a Spell to Special Summon itself and Set a Spell/Trap that mentions Dark Magician (The Eye of Timaeus or Legend of Heart) from the Deck, making The Eye of Timaeus live at once.
Illusion of Chaos
Reveals itself in hand to search Dark Magician, the Pharaoh's Servant or Magician's Rod.
Mirror Force
Sent from hand or field by The Fang of Critias to summon Mirror Force Dragon, or activated when the opponent attacks to wipe all their Attack Position monsters.
Crush Card Virus
Sent from hand or field by The Fang of Critias to summon Doom Virus Dragon.
Trap Trick
Sets Mirror Force or Crush Card Virus directly from your Deck so The Fang of Critias is always live.
extra: Ultimate Level 10 LIGHT Warrior Fusion boss ('Legendary Knight Timaeus' + 'Legendary Knight Critias' + 'Legendary Knight Hermos'): completely unaffected by other cards' effects, copies highest ATK on field, and floats into the 3 Legendary Knights!

Level 8 LIGHT Dragon Fusion ('The Fang of Critias' + 'Mirror Force'; 2800 ATK): whenever a monster you control is targeted for an attack or by an opponent's card effect, destroys ALL cards your opponent controls!
Level 4 DARK Dragon Fusion ('The Fang of Critias' + 'Crush Card Virus'; 1900 ATK): checks your opponent's field, hand, and draws for 3 turns and destroys all monsters with 1500 or more ATK!

Level 2 LIGHT Spellcaster Fusion summoned via The Claw of Hermos + 1 Spellcaster: equips to a monster and rolls a six-sided die before battle to banish the opponent's monster for that many Standby Phases!
Level 7 DARK Dragon Fusion summoned via The Claw of Hermos + 1 Dragon: equips to a monster to give it +1000 ATK plus +500 ATK/DEF for every Dragon on field/GY!
Level 4 LIGHT Warrior Fusion summoned via The Claw of Hermos + 1 Warrior: equips to a monster to negate the first effect activated each Battle Phase and grant a second attack!
Level 8 Dragon Fusion summoned via The Eye of Timaeus + Dark Magician: makes all Spells/Traps you control untargetable and indestructible!
Level 8 Dragon Fusion summoned via The Eye of Timaeus + Dark Magician that banishes Spells from GY to gain ATK.
